headline: The day Prohibition ended
post_facts: Utah was the 36th state to ratify

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen thirty-three... America's long dry spell came to an end.

scenes.label: New York City
scenes.caption: Agents pour liquor into a sewer
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] For almost fourteen years, Prohibition had banned alcohol sales nationwide.

scenes.label: state to ratify: Utah
scenes.text: [calmly] Then Utah became the thirty-sixth state to approve the Twenty-first Amendment.

scenes.title: Some states stayed dry
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Still, some states stayed dry... Mississippi, until nineteen sixty-six.

scenes.title: Did you know it lasted that long?
scenes.text: [gently] Did you know Prohibition lasted that long?
